title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics helpers + slo-toolkit utilities
author: Leah Kim
description: Motivation: on-call responders frequently need fast access to runbook steps and SLO context when a page fires. This PR introduces a set of helpers in incident-bot that: 1) surface compact runbook quicklinks in pager messages; 2) enrich diagnostics with SLO metadata from slo-toolkit; and 3) provide small utilities for sanitizing and caching runbook excerpts for low-latency lookup. Summary of changes: added a new oncall/runbook_helpers module, extended slo-toolkit bindings (slo_context_extractor), added caching layer with TTL and invalidation hooks, updated message formatting to include quicklinks and short diagnostic snippets, and expanded unit and integration tests. Changes are backwards compatible with current incident-bot configuration; rollout will be gradual (feature flag on by default for non-production) and we include a fast rollback plan (disable feature flag). Testing: unit tests for parsing and caching, integration tests exercising Slack/Email formatting and SLO enrichment, and an e2e smoke test against staging incident events. CI history: initial test run exposed a flaky TestRunbookParser due to a time-dependent fixture; fixed by normalizing timestamps in fixtures and re-running CI. See linked linear tickets for prioritization and context. Rollout: staged canary to engineering on-call followed by org-wide enablement over 72h if no regressions. Backports: none. Release note: small UX improvement for on-call responders: runbook quicklinks and SLO context now shown in incident notifications.
